schema: package-15 dedupe pair ground truth v1
definition: same_job = the two rows describe the SAME vacancy at the same employer and the same location, differing only in wording, punctuation, case or a formatting marker. A different city, a different seniority, a different pay grade, a different specialisation or a different requisition number makes them DIFFERENT jobs even at the same employer -- those are real separate vacancies and removing them would delete real data.
sampling: stratified across the cosine range 0.60-1.00 (24 per band) so the threshold is tuned on the region where the decision is actually hard, not on the easy tails
